1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

352|035b100d.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|035b100d.text: Where is it ye would like to go lass? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

1245-progress.name: Elling Trias
1245-progress.text: I see you're back, and in one piece. We both know you're not here for cheese, so let's cut out the pleasantries. Was Backus any help, or have you even left for Duskwood yet?
1245-progress.title: The Missing Diplomat

1250-accept.name: Tapoke "Slim" Jahn
1250-accept.text:
The Defias didn't pay me well enough to die for their cause. They took the king. Yeah, the king of Stormwind, not some lowly diplomat. He was on his way to Theramore to meet with Jaina Proudmoore--it was a big deal apparently, and a big secret. But it's not just the Defias that are involved. They're working with someone. I think they knew this was bigger than them.

My part was just to get their man on board the king's ship while it was moored. The guy's name was Hendel. That's all I know. I swear!
1250-accept.title: The Missing Diplomat

223-progress.name: Jonathan Carevin
223-progress.text: Yes, what is it? Make it quick, I've pressing matters to attend to.
223-progress.title: Worgen in the Woods

231-complete.name: A Weathered Grave
231-complete.text:
<A ghostly voice sounds on the wind...>

This is...? Sarah? Could it be she's still alive? The weight is removed from my shoulders...

$N. Take my sword, Archeus. As my soul is put to rest, I have no more need for it. It was forged to do good, and though I have proved myself unworthy to hold it, perhaps you will carry on the Light through it. And keep the ring. I am no longer worthy of it.

Lys, my love...
231-complete.title: A Daughter's Love

269-progress.name: Bishop Farthing
269-progress.text: Rest, sister.  I can tell you have traveled far, and you bear a heavy burden.  Can you tell me what casts that dark shadow over you?
269-progress.title: Seeking Wisdom
